cut: In src/probe.rs, replace the hand-written UTC calendar conversion with an RFC 3339 formatter and derive the human verdict label from the serialized outcome tag. In src/probe.rs and src/commands/doctor.rs, serialize a shared timestamp-and-outcome struct directly so doctor can drop the code that serializes the storage record and removes its command; collect fresh results into the lookup map once and pass it by reference to keep. In tests/doctor.rs, make Machine::rolesmith delegate to rolesmith_with with no overrides to reuse command setup.
answer: Done: the label comes from the serde tag; Probed {at, outcome} is serialized as doctor's probe and Kept flattens it with the command; fresh probes are collected into the map once and keep takes it by reference; Machine::rolesmith delegates to rolesmith_with. Not done: the RFC 3339 formatter, as Cargo.lock has no date crate (no time, chrono, humantime or jiff) and adding one would replace 15 lines unit-tested against date -u.
